blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Commission on Appointments (CA) on Monday confirmed the nomination of Douglas Michael Mallillin as chairperson of the Commission on Audit (COA), despite an earlier objection from Sen. Imee Marcos. During the hearing of the CA committee on constitutional commissions and offices, Mallillin’s nomination was nearly deferred after Marcos opposed the motion to endorse him for plenary approval, citing “serious concerns” about how COA supposedly uses its powers against the political opposition. “COA, rather than serving exclusively as an impartial guardian of public funds, has been allowed to become an instrument of political harassment in certain cases, with […]...
